decisions.reason: The candle arch is close to the core assortment and costs little to keep, but it has not been seen on the website since 2018, which weakens the case that its value is being realized.
The one-tier pyramid uses established workshop skills at low holding cost, so the option stays open despite its lower visibility after the pandemic seasons.
The electronic music box line is the firm's distant growth option and has not appeared since 2018, but as a declared flagship it gets one more season before abandonment.

The motif platform is a low-visibility accessory far from the core that has shown no evidence of value for several years, so dropping it frees resources while the music box line can continue without it.
The Christmas platform duplicates the accessory role of other music box parts and has given no sign of traction, so the option is unlikely to pay off and is better closed.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on core competencies and has gift and tourist appeal that should recover after the pandemic, so keeping it is cheap.
